description: TEST MODE ONLY (lh_test_ key and a test deposit address): record a fake deposit so the integration can be tested end to end; it becomes a test order that settles with webhooks. The amount decides the outcome: base units ending in 4001 -> refunded, 4002 -> failed, anything else -> filled. Moves no real funds. Fails with a live key.

amount.description: Deposit amount in HUMAN units of the address token ("25" = 25 USDC). Give this or amountBaseUnits.

amountBaseUnits.description: Deposit amount in base units (e.g. "25004001" to test a refund for a 6-decimal token). Give this or amount.

name: simulate_deposit
title: Simulate a deposit (test mode only)
